blocks.text: SAN FRANCISCO, Agusan del Sur — Police arrested two graduating college students on Thursday following a pre-dawn drinking brawl that left a 46-year-old man dead and another wounded in this town, authorities said Friday. Brig. Gen. Rolindo M. Suguilon, regional director of Police Regional Office 13 (PRO-13), identified the suspects through their aliases as “Rommel,” 25, of Loreto town, and “Nomer,” 23, of Esperanza town. Both are fourth-year college students. Investigators from the San Francisco municipal police station reported that the altercation broke out around 2:40 a.m. in Purok 4, Barangay II.
